newsitem.title: GERMANY: AMB sets AM Konzernrueck merger details.
newsitem.headline: AMB sets AM Konzernrueck merger details.

text.p: German insurer AMB Aachener und Muenchener Beteiligungs AG said on Thursday it has offered 1,657 marks per share for AM Konzernrueckversicherungs AG as part of its previously-announced takeover plan.
AMB, which currently owns 90.8 percent of AM Konzern, said it had valued the acquisition at 944 million marks in making the offer for remaining 50-mark nominal value shares in the reinsurer.
AMB said earlier in May that it planned to merge with AM Konzern in a bid to establish a coordinated reinsurance strategy.
The valuation was made based on company accounts as of December 31, 1996 and the deal, if approved by shareholders, would be retroactive to that date, AMB said in a statement.
The company values are subject to certification by merger auditors and by shareholders of AM Konzern at an ordinary general meeting to be held on August 28.
